reason: 该插件的主要面向功能是为文本交互场景提供图像转文本的辅助能力，README 明确说明其用于图片→文本描述，并可在浏览器截图与聊天贴图降级时作为备用；因此归类为媒体工具类的视觉描述插件，而非代码生成、测试或协作通信类能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件为聊天与网页截图场景提供图片转文本的辅助功能，可将图像内容转为描述文本用于文本模型处理。
summaries.en: This plugin adds image-to-text support for chat and browser-screenshot workflows, turning image content into text for text-model workflows.

capabilities: Generate text descriptions from images via a vision helper flow
Expose a `vision_describe` capability for fallback description generation
Use configured vision model settings for fallback behavior
Integrate image-description flow with browser screenshot and chat fallback workflows
